PluginData.Author: CometWorks
PluginData.Tooltip: Space Engineers cluster: World Authority node (dedicated server)
PluginData.Description: Turns this dedicated server into the World Authority of a Space Engineers cluster: the single writer of identities, factions, GPS, economy, chat, encounters, weather and the game clock that every regular node follows, and the owner of the global save. Started with CLUSTER_NODE_ROLE=WA by the cluster CLI. Requires the Direct Transport plugin.
